meta.subtitle: LOX / Ethanol Bi-Propellant Test Stand
meta.notes: Edit this file to match YOUR stand. Every valve, sensor, P&ID symbol, autosequence and controller below is generated from this file. Nothing is hard-coded in the UI.

bangbang.name: Fuel Tank Press (Fuel BB)
bangbang._ventValve: UNVERIFIED - leave null until the wiring is confirmed. Two things are unresolved: whether the board's BB vent solenoid is this GN2 vent at all (hardware.json marks DC3/DC4 as pushbutton channels PB1/PB3, while the BB press valves are solenoids S1/S2), and whether the heartbeat's vent01 bit reports COIL state or FLOW state. These vents are normally-open, so the two readings are opposites: setting this now makes the board's 'not venting' reopen a vent the operator just closed.

autosequences.name: Safe All
autosequences.description: Command every actuator to its configured safe state.

steps.message: Driving all actuators to safe state

autosequences.name: HOT FIRE
autosequences.description: Full burn. Pre-purge, ox lead, 5 s burn, cutoff and post-purge. This stand has no igniter channel — ignition is external.

autosequences.name: Detank / Post-Test
autosequences.description: Secure after a test: controllers off, press valves shut, tanks vented down, then both propellant lines purged clear.

autosequences.name: ABORT
autosequences.description: Emergency safing: mains closed, press closed, vents open, chamber purged.

steps.message: Abort state reached — stand is venting
